conditions.pageUserAgent: BenchPageFetcher/1.0 (compatible; reads public pages for a web search benchmark; obeys robots.txt)

agreement.gate: 0 human labels, need 100; judge-human weighted kappa n/a below 0.6

ranking.rule: Quality first, then reliability. Providers whose usable-response rate is confidently below the floor rank below all others. Within each band, a provider ties with the group leader unless the 95% paired-bootstrap interval of their known-answer difference excludes zero and the difference is at least the minimum separation. Cost and latency never affect rank.

providers.reason: kept the default: no candidate is clearly better (gain of at least 0.06 with a 95% interval above zero)
